task: Dashboard feedback from Irtiza: the 'Add a task' form and per-project 'Post an update' forms were not easy to find on the page. Make them significantly more visually prominent/discoverable regardless of where someone lands on the page - this is a real usability bug, not just a nice-to-have.

Riley.output: Moved 'Add a task' out of a scrollable section into a sticky header button (always visible regardless of scroll position) that opens a native <dialog>. Each project's 'Post an update' is now a prominent, colored <details>/<summary> disclosure button on every card instead of a small plain form easy to miss. Verified keyboard (Tab focus, Escape closes dialog) and touch (mobile viewport) behavior with Playwright.
